_comment: Trends Radar themes. Edit freely. 'proxies' = ETFs/indices that represent the theme; 'companies' = representative listed exposure (NOT recommendations); 'benchmark' = what relative strength is measured against; 'keywords' drive news attention (word-boundary match; ≤4-char keywords must match whole words); 'indicators' = registry symbols or FRED series ids shown as related context. 'beneficiaries'/'losers'/'risks'/'invalidation' are a static analytical framework, labelled as such in the UI. Symbols verified on Yahoo Finance 2026-11-24.

themes.name: Artificial intelligence
themes.beneficiaries: AI model developers with distribution, GPU/accelerator makers, hyperscalers monetising AI services
themes.losers: Labour-intensive services and software exposed to AI substitution; firms without data or distribution
themes.risks: AI capex not matched by revenue, power constraints, regulation, model commoditisation
themes.invalidation: Hyperscaler capex guidance cuts, falling AI revenue disclosures, sustained semis underperformance

themes.name: AI infrastructure
themes.beneficiaries: Accelerators, custom silicon, networking, servers, cooling and power equipment
themes.losers: Legacy enterprise hardware; utilities' customers facing higher power costs
themes.risks: Capex digestion phase, supply-chain bottlenecks, export controls, customer concentration
themes.invalidation: Order cancellations or guidance cuts at NVDA/AVGO/ANET; hyperscaler capex flattening

themes.name: Semiconductors
themes.beneficiaries: Leading-edge designers and foundries, equipment makers, high-bandwidth memory
themes.losers: Lagging-node producers facing China capacity; buyers squeezed on chip costs
themes.risks: Cyclical inventory corrections, US–China export controls, Taiwan risk
themes.invalidation: SMH relative strength turning negative on 3M with falling memory pricing

themes.name: Data centres
themes.beneficiaries: Data-centre REITs, power & cooling suppliers, power generators with spare capacity
themes.losers: Regions/users facing grid congestion and higher electricity prices
themes.risks: Rising rates (REIT valuations), power availability, overbuild
themes.invalidation: Vacancy rising / leasing slowdown disclosed by operators

themes.name: Cloud computing
themes.beneficiaries: Hyperscalers and consumption-based platforms
themes.losers: On-premise software and hardware vendors
themes.risks: IT budget cuts, AI cannibalising seat-based SaaS, price competition
themes.invalidation: Cloud revenue growth decelerating at the big three for consecutive quarters

themes.name: Cybersecurity
themes.beneficiaries: Platform security vendors; incident-response firms after major breaches
themes.losers: Breached companies; point-solution vendors losing to platforms
themes.risks: Valuation compression, vendor consolidation, budget scrutiny
themes.invalidation: Billings growth slowing across leaders; CIBR losing 3M relative strength

themes.name: Robotics & automation
themes.beneficiaries: Industrial and surgical robot makers, motion-control and vision suppliers
themes.losers: Labour-intensive manufacturers that do not automate
themes.risks: Industrial capex cycle, long commercialisation timelines for humanoids
themes.invalidation: Industrial orders falling; theme ETFs underperforming the S&P for 6M

themes.name: Quantum computing
themes.beneficiaries: Early hardware/software platforms if milestones are met
themes.losers: Classical encryption-dependent systems (long term)
themes.risks: Very early-stage, dilution, speculative retail flows
themes.invalidation: Missed technical milestones; collapse in speculative small-cap appetite

themes.name: Oil & gas
themes.beneficiaries: Producers, oil-services, oil exporters' currencies
themes.losers: Airlines, chemicals, oil importers such as India (current account, inflation)
themes.risks: OPEC+ supply decisions, demand slowdown, conflict-driven spikes reversing
themes.invalidation: Brent trending below its 200DMA with rising inventories

themes.name: Nuclear energy
themes.beneficiaries: Existing nuclear fleet operators, fuel cycle, SMR developers
themes.losers: Gas-fired generators if nuclear PPAs displace them (long term)
themes.risks: Regulatory delays, cost overruns, policy reversals
themes.invalidation: Cancellation of announced tech-company nuclear PPAs; URA/NLR losing 3M RS

themes.name: Uranium
themes.beneficiaries: Miners and enrichers with Western supply
themes.losers: Utilities buying fuel at higher contract prices
themes.risks: Spot price volatility, Russian enrichment sanctions, mine restarts
themes.invalidation: Term uranium price falling; miners underperforming

themes.name: Renewable energy
themes.beneficiaries: Utility-scale developers, domestic panel makers under tariffs
themes.losers: Fossil generators in competitive markets
themes.risks: Interest rates, subsidy/tax-credit changes, Chinese overcapacity
themes.invalidation: Policy credit repeal; ICLN/TAN below 200DMA with negative 6M RS

themes.name: Electricity infrastructure
themes.beneficiaries: Grid equipment, engineering & construction, gas turbines
themes.losers: Power-intensive industries facing higher tariffs
themes.risks: Valuation, supply bottlenecks, permitting
themes.invalidation: Utility capex plans cut; backlog growth stalling

themes.name: Defence
themes.beneficiaries: Prime contractors, munitions, European and Indian defence makers
themes.losers: Fiscal space for other spending
themes.risks: Budget gridlock, ceasefires reducing urgency, programme cost overruns
themes.invalidation: Defence budgets flat in real terms; ITA losing 6M RS

themes.name: Aerospace
themes.beneficiaries: Engine makers, aftermarket parts suppliers
themes.losers: Airlines when capacity is constrained and fuel is high
themes.risks: Production quality issues, supply chain, travel demand
themes.invalidation: Delivery rates falling; aftermarket pricing slowing

themes.name: Critical minerals & rare earths
themes.beneficiaries: Non-China producers and processors, recyclers
themes.losers: Manufacturers dependent on Chinese supply
themes.risks: China export curbs (two-way), price collapses, project delays
themes.invalidation: Easing of China export restrictions with falling prices

themes.name: Supply-chain restructuring
themes.beneficiaries: Mexico, India, Vietnam manufacturing; US industrial construction
themes.losers: China-centric exporters; importers paying tariffs
themes.risks: Tariff reversals, cost inflation, slow execution
themes.invalidation: Trade deals restoring China sourcing; EWW/INDA lagging

themes.name: US–China technology competition
themes.beneficiaries: Non-Chinese foundries/equipment for Western supply; Chinese domestic substitutes
themes.losers: Equipment makers with high China revenue; Chinese firms cut off from advanced chips
themes.risks: Sudden rule changes, retaliation via rare earths
themes.invalidation: Broad US–China détente rolling back controls

themes.name: Gold
themes.beneficiaries: Miners, gold holders, gold-loan lenders
themes.losers: Jewellery demand at high prices; India's import bill
themes.risks: Rising real yields, strong dollar, central-bank buying slowing
themes.invalidation: Gold below 200DMA with rising real yields (see Gold page)

themes.name: Banking
themes.beneficiaries: Banks when the curve steepens and credit is benign
themes.losers: Borrowers when credit tightens
themes.risks: Credit losses, commercial real estate, deposit competition
themes.invalidation: HY spreads widening sharply; KBE losing 3M RS

themes.name: Private credit
themes.beneficiaries: Alternative asset managers raising credit funds
themes.losers: Banks losing lending share
themes.risks: Opacity, defaults in a downturn, redemption gates
themes.invalidation: Rising non-accruals at BDCs; BIZD below 200DMA

themes.name: Interest rates / duration
themes.beneficiaries: Long bonds, utilities, REITs, growth stocks when yields fall
themes.losers: Banks' margins and savers when rates fall; long bonds when inflation re-accelerates
themes.risks: Inflation persistence, fiscal supply, term-premium rise
themes.invalidation: 10Y yield breaking higher with rising breakevens

themes.name: Cryptocurrency
themes.beneficiaries: Exchanges, treasury-holding companies, miners in uptrends
themes.losers: Leveraged holders in drawdowns
themes.risks: Regulation, leverage unwinds, liquidity
themes.invalidation: BTC below 200DMA with ETF outflows

themes.name: India manufacturing
themes.beneficiaries: EMS, capital goods, electricals under PLI and China+1
themes.losers: Importers of finished goods
themes.risks: Rich valuations, execution, global slowdown
themes.invalidation: Order inflows slowing; basket underperforming Nifty on 6M

themes.name: India defence
themes.beneficiaries: PSU defence manufacturers, shipyards, electronics
themes.risks: Valuation, order timing, export approval delays
themes.invalidation: Order book growth stalling; basket losing 3M RS vs Nifty

themes.name: India infrastructure
themes.beneficiaries: EPC, cement, ports, capital goods
themes.risks: Government capex slowdown, election-cycle pauses, commodity costs
themes.invalidation: Government capex below budget; Nifty Infra losing 6M RS

themes.name: India banking
themes.beneficiaries: Large private and PSU banks with deposit franchises
themes.risks: Deposit competition, unsecured-loan stress, RBI tightening
themes.invalidation: Bank Nifty below 200DMA with rising NPAs

themes.name: India renewable energy
themes.beneficiaries: Power producers, transmission, equipment makers
themes.risks: Tariff pressure, land/transmission delays, rates
themes.invalidation: Capacity addition targets missed; basket underperforming

themes.name: India pharmaceuticals
themes.beneficiaries: US generics exporters (weak rupee helps), CDMOs
themes.risks: US FDA actions, US tariffs on pharma, price erosion
themes.invalidation: US pharma tariffs or FDA warning letters at leaders

themes.name: India consumption
themes.beneficiaries: Staples, discretionary retail, autos when income growth improves
themes.risks: Food inflation, weak rural wages, valuation
themes.invalidation: Volume growth slowing for FMCG leaders
